name: Yishun
parking: Yishun is mostly HDB estates with multi-storey car parks and open-air lots, plus condo basement car parks around the town centre.
line: The detailer sets up in your Yishun car park, with Khatib and Yishun MRT close by and the base only a short hop away.

name: Seletar
parking: Seletar is mostly the Seletar Hills landed estate, where cars sit in private driveways, plus the Seletar Aerospace area. The Fernvale side belongs to Sengkang.
line: For Seletar Hills driveways and Aerospace Park car parks, the detailer comes from the nearby Yishun base with the full mobile kit.

name: Sembawang
parking: Sembawang has HDB blocks with open-air lots and multi-storey car parks, newer estates around Canberra, and a few landed streets near the old Sembawang Road area.
line: Whether you park near Sembawang MRT or in the Canberra estates, the detailer brings the kit to your car park.

name: Ang Mo Kio
parking: Ang Mo Kio is dense HDB, with many multi-storey car parks and open-air lots beside the blocks. Yio Chu Kang has quieter streets and some landed homes.
line: Right off the CTE, the detailer reaches Ang Mo Kio and Yio Chu Kang car parks and works on the spot.

name: Woodlands
parking: Woodlands is large and mostly HDB, with multi-storey car parks at the older blocks and open-air lots in newer ones. Admiralty and Marsiling add more HDB and condo basement car parks.
line: At the northern edge of the island, the detailer drives to Woodlands, Admiralty and Marsiling car parks for a full mobile detail.

name: Sengkang
parking: Sengkang is mainly newer HDB estates with multi-storey car parks, plus condo basement car parks near the MRT and along the waterway.
line: Sengkang car parks near the TPE and the MRT are within the detailer's mobile range from Yishun.

name: Punggol
parking: Punggol has recent HDB towns with multi-storey car parks, and many condo developments with basement parking near the waterway.
line: The detailer comes to Punggol HDB and condo basement car parks, a short run from the Yishun base.

name: Upper Thomson
parking: Upper Thomson is a mix of condo basement car parks along the main road and landed streets in the Sembawang Hills and Springleaf areas, with cars often in driveways.
line: Along Upper Thomson Road and the nearby landed streets, the detailer works at your driveway or car park.

name: Bishan
parking: Bishan has HDB estates with multi-storey car parks and open-air lots, plus condo basement car parks near the town centre.
line: With the CTE running through Bishan, the detailer reaches your HDB or condo car park without a long detour.

name: Serangoon
parking: Serangoon has HDB car parks and condo basements near the town centre, and the Serangoon Gardens estate has landed homes with private driveways.
line: Near NEX and Serangoon Gardens, the detailer sets up at your car park or driveway with the full kit.

name: Hougang
parking: Hougang is mostly HDB, with open-air lots and multi-storey car parks beside the blocks, and some condo basement car parks.
line: Close to the KPE, the detailer comes to Hougang car parks around the MRT and Kovan.

name: Toa Payoh
parking: Toa Payoh is an older HDB town with many multi-storey car parks and open-air lots, plus some condo basement car parks.
line: The detailer drives to Toa Payoh car parks near the PIE and the town centre and works on site.

name: Bukit Panjang
parking: Bukit Panjang is mostly HDB with multi-storey car parks and open-air lots, plus condo basement car parks near the MRT and LRT.
line: Along the BKE in Bukit Panjang, the detailer brings the full mobile kit to your HDB or condo car park.
